alt: A bandaged detective points down a dark alley with total, serene confidence, certain and pointing the wrong way.
A clerk stamps a fresh folder at his desk beside a bank of filing cabinet drawers, smugly certain a properly dated record is the only thing that survives a dispute.
A figure presses both palms flat to a wall in total darkness, eyes shut, one finger lighting up the instant it feels a tremor it cannot locate.
A jailer studies a glowing stopwatch with its hand almost at the end of the sweep, one palm already on the bolt, unmoved and about to close the door.
A gremlin perched on a ladder repaints an already-empty room, brush loaded and bored, because nothing had to change for it to redo the work anyway.
A performer stands between two stage doors adjusting a costume that no longer fits the part, a rack of other roles waiting in the dark behind them.
A hooded courier holds out a small glowing note while unseen hands drag at his cloak to strike him down for carrying it.
A cloaked ferryman poles a laden boat away from a crumbling dock, raising an amber lantern toward a passenger's hand still reaching from the dock across the widening gap.
A guard winces as he turns a key set into a lock built into his own chest, sealing something away from himself as surely as from anyone else.
A many-headed hydra severs one of its own necks with a satisfied snip, two new heads already budding at the stump before the cut lands.
A captain stands clean-handed at the helm pointing at a chart, while a crew of identical rowers strains in unison below deck doing all the actual work.
A single vast hand reaches up through a hatch to complete a blueprint, filling in the missing corner with something plausible that was never drawn.
A featureless black figure steps calmly out of a hairline crack in the wall at the worst possible moment, and every professional in the room reacts too late.
A bandaged, confident figure points the wrong way down a lamplit alley while a huddle of trusting instruments follow the gesture without question.
A jailer studies a glowing stopwatch at a cell door while a line of weary night workers wait to make their case before it closes.
A gremlin repaints an already-empty room from a ladder, because the room redraws itself whether or not anyone asked it to.
A courier holds out a small glowing note to a judge whose gavel is already falling, the note the only evidence anyone in the room is looking at.
A ferryman poles a boat of passengers away from a crumbling shore toward a distant vault door, the crossing visibly one-way on both banks.
A single performer, split down the middle into two different costumes, holds open two stage doors at once, belonging fully to neither.
A clerk stamps a fresh folder while an unbroken chain of tied, dated folders recedes into the dark behind him, every one still accounted for.
A captain charts a course while his crew rows below deck and a many-headed sea serpent keeps pace alongside the hull, always one head ahead.
